questions.stem: 5 g of salt is dissolved in 250 cm³ of water. What is the concentration in g/dm³?
questions.explanation: First convert volume to dm³: 250 cm³ = 0.25 dm³. Then use concentration = mass/volume = 5/0.25 = 20 g/dm³.

questions.stem: How many moles of NaOH are in 25 cm³ of 0.1 mol/dm³ solution?
questions.explanation: Convert volume: 25 cm³ = 0.025 dm³. Then use n = c × V = 0.1 × 0.025 = 0.0025 mol. Always remember to convert cm³ to dm³ by dividing by 1000.
